declarations.name: KlAmountInput
declarations.description: Money entry with live, locale-aware grouping. value is an exact decimal string; never a float.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Decimal in the main unit, e.g. "45000.50". Submitted padded to the currency's decimals.

members.name: value
members.description: Decimal in the main unit, e.g. "45000.50". Submitted padded to the currency's decimals.

declarations.name: KlButton
declarations.description: Triggers an action. The element itself is the button; inside a form it submits or resets.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Square, icon-only. Give it an aria-label.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and ignores activation.

attributes.name: popovertarget
attributes.description: Id of a popover to toggle, like on <button>.

members.name: icon
members.description: Square, icon-only. Give it an aria-label.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and ignores activation.

members.name: popoverTarget
members.description: Id of a popover to toggle, like on <button>.

declarations.name: KlCheckbox
declarations.description: A checkbox whose content is its label. Submits value when checked.

declarations.name: KlField
declarations.description: Wires a label, control, hint and inline error together. Errors show after blur or a submit attempt.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Show this message now and mark the control invalid until cleared.

members.name: error
members.description: Show this message now and mark the control invalid until cleared.

slots.name: error
slots.description: Optional fixed error text; otherwise the control's validation message is used.

declarations.name: KlInput
declarations.description: Single-line text input. Form-associated; copies the native validity of its inner <input>.

declarations.name: KlMenu
declarations.description: A popover menu opened by any button with popovertarget. Arrow keys, type-to-find, Escape and outside click to close.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ item: Element; value: string | null }>

declarations.name: KlSelect
declarations.description: Choose one option. <kl-select> is a custom select-only combobox; <select class="kl-select"> is the styled native one (OS picker).

declarations.name: KlOtpInput
declarations.description: Boxes drawn over one real input, so SMS autofill, paste, password managers and screen readers work.

declarations.name: KlStepper
declarations.description: Progress indicator for multi-step flows. Markers are numbered by CSS; complete steps show a check.

declarations.name: KlSwitch
declarations.description: On/off switch (role=switch) whose content is its label. For settings that apply immediately.

declarations.name: KlTabs
declarations.description: WAI-ARIA tabs over your own buttons and panels (paired by value or order). Your elements are never moved.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ value: string; tab: Element; panel: Element | null }>

declarations.name: KlTransactionList
declarations.description: Grouped, formatted transactions. The element renders from data (text only, safe links); the classes are for framework-rendered markup.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: { id, title, amount, currency?, direction?, date, meta?, status?, icon?, href? }

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: today, yesterday, received, sent, pending, failed, empty

members.name: items
members.description: { id, title, amount, currency?, direction?, date, meta?, status?, icon?, href? }

members.name: labels
members.description: today, yesterday, received, sent, pending, failed, empty
